meaning: Fake text messages that try to make you click a link or share personal information.
clues: It is an odd message that may ask for money or private facts.
It arrives as a text message, not as a phone call or a letter in the mail.
A link may lead to a fake site that asks for a login or card number.
Ignore it. Report it. Contact the real company another way.
It has eight letters and starts with S.

decoys.meaning: A phone call or voicemail that tries to get your information or money.
A call that plays a recorded message instead of a live person. Many are scams.
Faking the name or number on caller ID so a call looks like it is from someone else.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: If a text says your account has a problem, do not use its link. Open the company website yourself or call a number you already trust.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: An unexpected letter made us pause before replying. An unexpected text deserves that same pause.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: You can report unwanted texts to your phone company and the FTC.
